advancedConfig.title: Advanced Configuration
advancedConfig.dataProcessingHelp: As the widget operator (data controller), you are responsible for the lawful processing of your visitors' data. Synaplan acts as data processor on your behalf according to GDPR Art. 28.
advancedConfig.avvAcceptLabel: I acknowledge the data processing agreement
advancedConfig.avvAcceptDescription: By activating this, you confirm that you have a legal basis for processing your visitors' chat data (e.g. Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR), that you will inform visitors via your privacy policy, and that you accept Synaplan as data processor under the terms described below.

avvDetails.title: Data Processing Agreement Details (Art. 28 Abs. 3 GDPR)
avvDetails.subjectText: Synaplan provides AI-powered chat widget services. Personal data is processed to deliver real-time chat responses, store conversation history, and optionally retrieve external user data via configured APIs.
avvDetails.durationText: Data is processed for the duration of your Synaplan subscription. Upon account deletion or contract termination, all personal data will be deleted within 30 days.
avvDetails.dataCat3: Browser metadata (user agent, language, country via Cloudflare)
avvDetails.dataCat4: Uploaded files (if file upload is enabled)
avvDetails.dataCat5: User profile data from external APIs (name, email, custom fields — if User Data Integration is configured)
avvDetails.dataSubjectsText: Website visitors who interact with the chat widget, and optionally authenticated users whose data is provided via external API.
avvDetails.instructionsText: Synaplan processes data exclusively based on your documented instructions. The widget configuration (prompts, flow rules, API settings) constitutes your instructions. Processing beyond these instructions only occurs if required by EU/member state law.
avvDetails.tom1: TLS encryption for all data in transit (HTTPS only)
avvDetails.tom2: Encrypted database storage with access controls
avvDetails.tom3: Confidentiality obligations for all personnel with data access
avvDetails.tom4: Regular security updates and vulnerability monitoring
avvDetails.subprocessorsText: AI model providers (configurable: Ollama self-hosted, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Google Gemini) may process chat messages for generating responses. The specific sub-processor depends on your AI model configuration. You will be notified of sub-processor changes.
avvDetails.rightsTitle: 8. Data Subject Rights (Art. 28 Abs. 3 lit. e)
avvDetails.rightsText: Synaplan assists you in fulfilling data subject requests (access, rectification, deletion, portability). Chat data can be exported or deleted via the dashboard at any time.
avvDetails.deletionText: Upon contract termination, all personal data is deleted within 30 days. You can export your data before termination via the dashboard. Individual chat sessions can be deleted at any time.
avvDetails.breachText: Synaplan will notify you without undue delay (within 72 hours) upon becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting your widget data.
avvDetails.auditText: You have the right to verify compliance with this agreement. Synaplan will provide necessary information and allow for audits upon reasonable notice.
